options: A macro that expands to 100 everywhere
100 is stored in a const variable named MAX
MAX is a pointer to 100
MAX is a runtime variable
explanation: Preprocessor directives like #define are textual substitutions at compile-time, not runtime variables.
SQUARE(2+3) expands to 2+3*2+3 due to lack of parentheses, evaluated as 2+(3*2)+3=11.

options: extern promises the declaration will exist elsewhere; the second defines it
extern creates an alias; the second shadows it
Both statements do the same thing redundantly
extern prevents the second line from being executed
explanation: extern declares a variable with external linkage that will be defined elsewhere (or later); the second line provides the definition.

options: Quoted includes search the current directory first; angle brackets search system paths
Angle brackets search current directory first; quoted includes search system paths
Both are identical; the syntax is just a style choice
Quoted includes are for functions; angle brackets are for constants
explanation: Quoted includes prioritize the current directory; angle-bracket includes go directly to system include paths.

options: Linker error: multiple definitions of func
The second definition silently overwrites the first
The compiler error prevents reaching link time
Only the forward declaration is used
explanation: Two function definitions with the same signature cause a linker error for multiple symbol definitions.

options: The block scope; it shadows the outer x within braces
The file scope; both refer to the same variable
The inner x is invalid syntax
The outer x is deleted when the inner block starts
explanation: Inner block declarations create block scope and shadow outer declarations of the same name.

options: static storage duration; x is allocated once and persists across calls
Global variables always retain their value between function calls
The compiler optimizes func to increment a global register
func allocates x on the heap, not the stack
explanation: static storage duration means x is allocated once at program start and retains its value across function calls.

question:
#define DEBUG 1
#if DEBUG
printf("Debug");
#endif
When is the printf evaluated?
options: At compile-time; the preprocessor includes or excludes the code before compilation
At runtime; the #if is a conditional statement like if()
Never; #if is a compile-time constant that cannot contain side effects
Both at compile-time and runtime depending on DEBUG value
explanation: Preprocessor conditionals like #if are evaluated at preprocessing, before actual compilation, controlling which code is even compiled.

options: Undefined behavior: string literals are read-only
The character is successfully changed to uppercase
Compiler error: cannot assign to string literals
A new mutable copy is created and modified
explanation: String literals have read-only storage; attempting to modify them causes undefined behavior (typically a segfault).

options: Allows using Node directly without struct keyword
Creates an alias that is only valid in this scope
Reserves memory for n at typedef time
Makes the struct behave like a primitive type
explanation: typedef creates an alias for the type, allowing Node to be used directly without the struct keyword prefix.
